text:
Apply the proved Radon--Nikodym theorem on this exact space.
The densities \(Z_+,Z_-\) are \(\mathcal G\)-measurable and nonnegative.
For a \(\mathcal G\)-measurable function and a member of \(\mathcal G\),
the integral against \(P|_{\mathcal G}\) equals the integral against
\(P\), by \cref{thm:p15-w02c-p15-007-restricted-integral}. Hence
\(\int_AZ_\pm\,dP=\nu_\pm(A)\) for \(A\in\mathcal G\), and \(Z_\pm\) are
\(P\)-integrable with integrals \(EX^+,EX^-\).
\Cref{thm:p15-w02c-p15-007-density-version} writes out each step of this
construction against \(P\).

text:
The densities are characterized by integrals against the restriction of
\(P\) to \(\mathcal G\); \cref{thm:p15-w02c-p15-007-restricted-integral}
identifies these with integrals against \(P\), and
\cref{thm:p15-w02c-p15-007-density-version} carries the construction
through with every integral taken against \(P\).
